content.short: A CNFT collection of different medicine tablets, capsules and solutions as 3D objects viewable in AR platforms.
content.description:
AdaMeds is a CNFT collection of 10,000 different variants of medicine tablets, capsules, and solutions as 3D objects viewable in augmented-reality platforms. Most of the meds in this collection are for flu, but a rare few are for some "special" conditions.

It’s 2022. Covid-19 is still here. Vaccines are not really stopping it. People are now hoarding paracetamol and other flu medicines. Idiots are throwing money at meme tokens on every blockchain, including and especially Cardano. So WTF! Why not another one for those who hoard stuff they don't need? In this collection, there are 13 different medicines each with varying dosage, form and preparation. Collect at least one each of 10 different medicines and you can convert them into 1 vaccine shot CNFT.

Collect 3 vaccine CNFTs and you can convert them into the most coveted “booster shot”. Assuming there are still enough stupid idiots who will buy this crap, 30% of the net proceeds from this project will go towards helping people who are really in need of meds and supplies in the Philippines. Our team itself plans to organize the distribution efforts but in case we get lazy, this will be donated to a non-government charitable organization in the Philippines.

The other 70% will go to our jet ski fund. We initially wanted a yacht like those bastards behind HOSKY. But we just found out it’s too expensive and a pain-in-the-ass to maintain. We don’t wanna deal with that shit. So now we’re just going for something we can just tuck into an already-cramped garage. Why are you still reading this?
